description: Energieerzeugungsanlagen - Biomethan-Einspeiseanlagen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by energieportal-brandenburg.de. The service contains information on biomethane feed-in plants in the state of Brandenburg. Shown are operated biomethane feed-in plants. The data source is the market master data register of the Federal Network Agency and the information platform of the four German transmission system operators. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Energy generation plants - Biomethane feed-in plants" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Biomasseanlagen, Biomasse, Brandenburg, Erneuerbare Energie, Energieerzeugungsanlagen, Energie. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
